name: Sinolong New Materials Co Ltd
summary: Sinolong New Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive lifecycle of advanced thin film materials and related products, encompassing their research, development, manufacturing, and commercial distribution. The company's diverse portfolio features high-performance biaxially oriented polyamide films, environmentally friendly biaxially oriented polylactic acid films, and Polyamide 6. Established on November 19, 2018, the firm maintains its headquarters in Xiamen, China.
